set.body: Evidence from ScalaFIM mesh4s integration at mesh4s dfcb875 and locus4s eec9a4b. Generated strict open grids: 10,449 vertices/20,480 faces and 163,842 vertices/326,032 faces. JVM ingestion (TriangleMesh plus SurfaceRealization plus renderer rendition) allocated 157,865,432 B in 352 ms and 2,035,842,624 B in 1.35 s. Scala.js FastOpt topology/realization construction took 249 ms with observed +63,474,256 B heap/+134,365,184 B RSS, and 2,769 ms with +776,726,952 B heap/+822,083,584 B RSS. Likely hot allocation sites are per-face Triangle.toVector/groupBy/sorted maps, per-vertex link HashMaps/ArrayBuffers, and the second compileStorage hash pass. Optimize without weakening strict audits or topology witnesses. Acceptance: preserve all mesh4s JVM/JS laws and adversarial audits; add both scale fixtures; reduce the 163,842 case below 1 GiB JVM cumulative allocation and below 512 MiB observed Scala.js RSS delta on the reference receipt, with deterministic topology identity and edge order unchanged.
set.title: Optimize mesh4s cortical-scale topology construction
